name: Buck's-horn Plantain
desc: Buck's-horn Plantain (Plantago coronopus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Plantago coronopus, the buck's-horn plantain, is a herbaceous annual to perennial flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. Other common names in the US and Italy include minutina and erba stella.
